subject: Payments Feature — Sprint Planning Kickoff
body:
Hi team,

I wanted to kick off the sprint planning discussion for our upcoming Payments feature rollout. As per the Q4 roadmap, we are targeting a release date of December 15, 2024.

Key deliverables this sprint:
- Payment gateway integration (Stripe) — assigned to Arjun Mehta
- PCI-DSS compliance audit — assigned to Kenji Nakamura
- Backend API for charge/refund endpoints — assigned to Riya Desai
- Frontend checkout UI — to be coordinated with the product team

Please review ticket NEX-204 which tracks the overall Payments epic. The PCI-DSS compliance requirement is a blocker for go-live, so Kenji please flag any blockers as soon as possible.

I'll schedule the kickoff call for tomorrow at 10 AM IST.

Best,
Priya Sharma
Engineering Manager, Nexora Inc.
